notes: College of Arts and Humanities official four-year academic plan for Arabic Studies. The PDF-to-text conversion of the term grid is badly garbled (columns and a separate 'Major Requirements' checklist table appear interleaved), but the core-sequence placement in Year 1 (ARAB101 Fall, ARAB102 Spring) is legible and reliable, as is the count and identity of the named elective slots. Gen Ed and general-elective slots (ENGL 101, Math, ARHU 158, 'Elective 1xx-4xx', etc.) are left out entirely, per the pattern: only the major is audited.
'One ARAB Foundation Elective' slot filled with ARAB222 (named directly in the plan as 'ARAB 222 (Foundation Elective)').
'Two ARAB Foundation Electives' slot filled with ARAB325 and ARAB317 (both named directly in the plan as 'ARAB 325 (Foundation Elective)' and 'ARAB 317 (Foundation Elective)').
'ARAB 2xx (Elective in English)' slot filled with ARAB250 (Food Cultures in the Global Middle East, a 200-level Optional Elective), since the plan does not name a specific course for this slot.

The two 'ARAB 3xx-4xx' slots filled with ARAB401 and ARAB410 (both Optional Electives; ARAB401 is taught in Arabic, satisfying the catalog's 'at least one 3-credit optional elective taught in Arabic' rule -- unencoded in the Program itself since the engine has no language-of-instruction attribute), since the plan does not name specific courses for these slots.

Exact term placement (which year/semester) for the 6 elective courses is reconstructed rather than read verbatim, because the source's term-grid OCR is garbled beyond reliable per-term parsing; the requirement-satisfying set of 12 courses and their identities are read directly from the source's own labels, only their year/semester slotting is estimated. Flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md.
